title: Why Some Classrooms Have Far More Pupils Than Teachers
hook: In some countries, one teacher is responsible for more students than a small school.
closing: School scale shapes how much time and support each child can actually receive.
question: Which school gap surprised you?

segments.say: India alone has 127.5 million secondary pupils, more than any other country.
In Guinea-Bissau, teachers face 147.6 students each, leaving almost no room for individual attention.
Education spending has fallen to 3.57 percent of national income even as enrollment keeps climbing.
Youth female literacy still reached 92 percent, proof schooling keeps paying off despite the strain.
In Tanzania, preschools already run 114 pupils per teacher -- the attention gap starts before a single lesson.
